about: Confession Bear shows a Malayan sun bear slumped against a log with its head tipped down and a sheepish, guilty-looking face, as if it has been working up the courage to admit something. The captions are confessions: small secrets, mildly shameful habits and opinions the poster would never say out loud, like never having watched a famous film or secretly enjoying a song everyone mocks. Its posture of quiet regret makes even trivial admissions feel like a heavy burden finally being shared.
origin: The bear is a Malayan sun bear captured in a news agency photograph. Reddit turned it into an advice animal in 2012, and it became the standard image for anonymous confessions on the site.
usage:
Split the confession across both boxes. The top box begins the admission and the bottom box finishes it with the guilty detail. Example: "i stole" / "the pic-i-nic basket".

The best confessions are relatable and low stakes, the kind of thing many readers secretly do too: re-gifting presents, pretending to have read the book, saying "on my way" while still in bed, or never having seen a movie everyone quotes. Write in the first person and keep the tone a little ashamed.
